senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; <cite ref="O01003"><he>סָלַל</he> I</cite> , v. <cite ref="O01011"><he>סִלְסֵל</he></cite>)

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 12:3">Men. XII, 3</cite> <he>קמח יביא ס׳</he> if one vows an offering of flour, he must bring fine flour.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 315:6">Sifré Deut. 315</cite> <he>ונושרות סוֹלְתָן וכ׳</he> and drop their flour on the ground.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:11">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>כל … לא ס׳</he> is not all of Solomon’s wisdom fine flour (choice)?; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Kiddushin 69b">Kidd. 69ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Kiddushin 71b">71ᵇ</cite> Ezra did not leave Babylonia, <he>עד שעשאה כס׳ נקיה</he> until he made her (the Jews in Babylonia) like the purest sifted flour, i.e. established the purity of descent of their families by careful investigation (cmp. <cite ref="P00629"><he>עִיסָה</he></cite>).—Pl. <he>סֳלָתוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:2">Esth. R. to I, 14</cite>, v. <cite ref="M02725"><he>מָרַס</he></cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: a dish made of fine flour, pudding.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 37a:4">Ber. 37ᵃ</cite> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20). Y. ib. VI, 10ᵇ; a. e.
